== Summary ==
Slip “•Power Of The Hutt” cut unchanged from page 2 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Virtual Set 21 release sheet, December 2023 edition] (PDF file created 30 December 2023), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (590, 1175, 1102, 1459)). Version [[Power Of The Hutt (V)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
